facts.value: Action-dispatch callback with signature void(HSD_GObj* gobj). The object supplies the Fighter whose directional input is interpreted by the common aerial selector; that selector uses C-stick input when ftCo_800DF478 succeeds and left-stick input otherwise. The callback returns no value.
facts.rationale: Preserves the correct signature while correcting the C-stick-only interpretation of the argument.

facts.value: Selects and enters Mr. Game & Watch's directional aerial attack using the common input selector, which uses C-stick input when ftCo_800DF478 succeeds and left-stick input otherwise. Neutral, back, and up aerials use character-specific entry routines; forward and down aerials use common entry. An unmatched motion ID produces no entry call.
facts.rationale: Corrects the input-source restriction without changing the supported dispatch explanation.

evidence.why: Five dispatch cases and no default action.

facts.value: Provides the owner-motion removal predicate for the Parachute article: returns false for every motion ID in the inclusive interval from ftGw_MS_AttackAirN through ftGw_MS_LandingAirN and true outside that interval. It does not remove the article or guarantee its continued existence.
facts.rationale: Replaces endpoint-only wording with the exact range operation and separates removal permission from article lifetime.

facts.value: Supplies the owner-state lifetime check for the Parachute article scheduled by Mr. Game & Watch's neutral aerial. It suppresses owner-state-driven removal within the inclusive AttackAirN-to-LandingAirN motion-ID interval, but the item animation can still request removal at animation frame exactly 30 or when its owner is absent.
facts.rationale: Corrects the claim that this predicate keeps the article alive throughout the move by including independent item-side expiry.

facts.value: First exits hitlag independently for every retained Parachute, Turtle, and Sparky article. With nonzero cmd_vars[0], initializes ftGw_MS_LandingAirB using landingairb_lag, schedules ftGw_AttackAirN_ItemTurtleOnLand, and returns. Otherwise enters basic landing and invokes character-wide article cleanup. The scheduled Turtle callback requests item state 1 only if its article exists and motion_id equals ftGw_MS_LandingAirN, not LandingAirB.
facts.rationale: Distinguishes initial hitlag exit from deferred item-state handling and preserves the mismatched landing guard.

facts.value: Resolves Fighter from gobj and independently forwards non-null Parachute, Turtle, and Sparky handles to it_802C6DD8, it_802C70E0, and it_802C73AC, the article hitlag-exit wrappers. It then reads cmd_vars[0]: nonzero calls ftGw_LandingAirHi_Init and stores ftGw_AttackAirN_ItemSparkyOnLand in accessory4_cb; zero calls ftCo_Landing_Enter_Basic followed by ftGw_Init_OnDamage. The initial article calls do not themselves select item landing states.
facts.rationale: Corrects the classification of the three item calls while retaining the exact input and callback flow.

facts.value: Handles landing entry from Mr. Game & Watch's up aerial by exiting hitlag for all retained aerial articles, then choosing dedicated LandingAirHi with a deferred Sparky OnLand callback when cmd_vars[0] is nonzero, or basic landing followed by character-wide article cleanup otherwise. Sparky's deferred callback only requests its item transition when an article exists and the fighter is in LandingAirN.
facts.rationale: Replaces misleading immediate landing-notification language with the actual hitlag operation and conditional deferred transition.

evidence.why: Nullable Sparky callback and LandingAirN guard.

facts.value: Resolves Fighter from gobj, reads the retained Parachute, Turtle, and Sparky handles, and forwards each non-null handle to its article-specific hitlag-exit wrapper. It then reads cmd_vars[0]: nonzero calls ftGw_LandingAirN_Init and stores ftGw_AttackAirN_ItemParachuteOnLand in accessory4_cb; zero calls ftCo_Landing_Enter_Basic and then ftGw_Init_OnDamage. The actual Parachute item-state transition is deferred to OnLand, while basic landing can select HammerLanding or ordinary Landing.
facts.rationale: Corrects item-call semantics and preserves the separately scheduled transition and fallback exception.

facts.value: Directional dispatch specializes neutral, back, and up aerial entry and delegates forward/down entry. Article removal predicates suppress owner-state-driven removal within inclusive motion-ID intervals; item-side owner loss and Parachute animation-frame equality to 30 provide additional expiry paths. Landing entry exits article hitlag, then selects dedicated landing with a deferred OnLand callback or basic landing with character-wide cleanup. All three OnLand item-transition guards compare against LandingAirN, including Turtle and Sparky. LandingAirHi uses landingairb_lag. Landing animation/collision callbacks clean up whenever their post-delegate motion ID differs from the dedicated landing state.
facts.rationale: Corrects the unit-level guarantee of persistence and matching landing transitions while retaining dispatch and lifecycle structure.

evidence.why: Complete fighter-side lifecycle, dispatch, landing guards and lag source.
